name: bollinger_ema_sar_slope_v2
purpose: Replace only the overly restrictive V1 lateral/trend filter; keep every other trading rule unchanged.
unchanged_from_v1: EMA3/EMA9 cross on fully closed signal bar
rocket rejection wick >= 70% of body OR body engulfing
higher-low LONG / lower-high SHORT signal shape
stop at low/high of candle immediately before signal candle

only_change.old_v1_filter: EMA20 had to rise/fall monotonically on each of the last 3 one-minute transitions.
only_change.new_v2_filter: Directional net EMA20 displacement over 5 closed bars, normalized by current Bollinger bandwidth.
only_change.reason: Allows small pullbacks inside a genuine slope instead of requiring every intermediate EMA20 step to be monotonic, while still rejecting near-flat conditions. Threshold is fixed before this run and is not optimized in this run.

comparison: V2 is compared directly with frozen V1 discovery results. No confirmatory or sealed holdout data may be used to choose this filter.
decision_rule: First evaluate whether V2 restores a usable sample without abandoning NO_TRADE in lateral conditions. Performance is descriptive at discovery stage and does not authorize live trading.
